en: Sailor
A sailor pal told me Team Aqua set up in Lilycove, and somebody sent them packing.
But it's Team Magma who've got their eye on Mossdeep. Want to know what they're after? Ask at the Space Center.
The sea's my life, but after a long voyage, setting foot on land again is a relief all the same.
Woman
The Space Center on this island launches great big rockets. There's been an uproar about some letter they got.
The Space Center on this island launches great big rockets. It's quite a sight when one goes up!
Man
A ship is a fine way to cross the sea. But riding a Pokémon with Surf? Now that's a thrill. Don't you agree?
Boy
Steven gave me this rock. He called it a King's Rock, I think. I don't know what it's for. Do you want it?
Really? You're strange. You can have it, but don't tell Steven.
Steven's house is right over there!
See? Nobody knows what to do with a weird old rock.
Scott
{player}! Feeling good? I came to see Mossdeep's Gym Leaders for myself. They're said to be quite something.
But something's off about this town. People keep talking about a warning letter and the Space Center...
Well, I don't suppose it's any of my business. See you!
Maxie
The fuel is in that building. Go!
Black Belt
A punch that leaves the foe dizzy! Shall I teach one of your Pokémon Dynamic Punch?
Good! Which one?
{wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...
{wearer} learned {thing}!
It doesn't always land, but when it does, the foe can't tell up from down!
Suit yourself. The offer won't run off.
An Egg can't throw a punch yet!
Hmm, that one can't learn Dynamic Punch.
That one already knows {thing}.
{forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that.
